This place has awesome fruits and vegetables. Perfectly ripe and delicious. The restaurant is fabulous if you want great authentic Mexican food and are in a hurry for lunch. I work at the thermal windows right across the intersection and I eat here once or twice a week. It has never disappointed once. The cooks understand enough English where gringos have no issue ordering. The best Mexican rice you can find. Prices are great on energy drinks. I highly recommend this grocery store.

So I went to the Cocina about an hour ago, and while I was waiting for my food to be packaged to go, I saw a very small cockroach, it was obviously a baby, and then a much larger cockroach crawled up onto the counter from the area where they pack the onions and cilantro themselves, not the area where customers get their own. I let the lady working know by pointing at the roach, and she just gasped and then laughed. It was appalling. I still took the food they made out of kindness, but I really shouldn’t have because I couldn’t bring myself to actually eat it. Felt sick to my stomach after seeing that. I used to eat there at least twice a week, but I don’t think I can bring myself to eat from there ever again.
